tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "24183DBC4C60BBA68A09E1AA89D01FC0", "The Mayor has initiated a Buy Order. Buy Orders are a way to exchange materials for Sanctus Scrip. Delivered materials are converted into Resources which help Settlements develop and grow.")

NSLOCTEXT("[FEA8EFE747B6BFEF48AD2AB3CBEF2B13]", "E7B1A4F2470E4F68B7951EBD667669FA", "Speak to a Requisition Agent to view and contribute to a Settlement\'s Buy Orders. You don\'t need to be a citizen to contribute, so be sure to check the Buy Orders often on your travels.")
